title: Cinderhead Mine - Pressure & Spark
_note: Option B mood sibling, more tense. gbc 4-voice band. A harmonic minor (raised 7th G#), 96bpm. Staccato low pulse25 motif, terse and recurring - a held-breath pulse rather than a melody; pulse12 fast nervous arpeggio flickering in short bursts (Sparkrat static) then cutting to silence; driving low tri_bass ostinato, a steady tense walk under the silence; dry pick-tap drums plus an occasional gust/static noise swell (Storm leaking in). Vesper: the rising leap clipped into a staccato stab E3->A3->B3 repeating like a nervous tic; the harmonic-minor G# sharpens the unease - the motif under strain. 24-bar loop; last bar voice-leads (E->A) home.
